us_econ: Inflation: CPI 3.7% y/y (2026-09), core 2.6%; core 3-month annualized 3.4%; core PCE 3.1%. Jobs: payrolls +165k in 2026-10 (3-month average +137k), unemployment 4.1% (-0.1), wages 3.1% y/y. Growth: real GDP 3.4% annualized in 2026-Q3, consumer spending 3.8%. Policy: fed funds target 3.75-4.0% (effective 3.88%); 2-year Treasury 4.56% (+0.68 vs fed funds: market pricing hikes); 10-year breakeven inflation 2.22%, real 10-year 2.66%. Farm prices (PPI farm products) +1.5% y/y; food-at-home CPI +1.8% y/y. For ags: high real yields and a firm dollar weigh on fund demand for commodities; sticky inflation keeps rates high (carry and storage costs up); a weak job market or falling real incomes hits meat and dairy demand first.

energy.read: Gas storage 3,801 Bcf (week to 2026-10-30), +77 Bcf vs a 5-year average +36 for the week; +40 Bcf (+1.1%) vs the 5-year average, -104 vs last year. Crude stocks 409.8 mb (-0.9 mb on the week, -5.2% vs 5-yr avg); gasoline -0.2 mb, distillate -3.6 mb; refinery utilization 94.5%. 3-2-1 crack $45.80/bbl (ULSD $92.00, gasoline $22.70). NG weather/positioning: squeeze risk HIGH (2 of 7 cold-risk checks on; managed money net -224,495 (1st pct of 3 yrs, -79,814 in 4 wks)). 15-day ensembles colder over 2-3 days: +9.9 HDD on matched dates (≈-16 Bcf); stratospheric wind at 60N -3.5 m/s (below 0 = SSW; surface effect lags 2-8 weeks). Squeeze risk high: forecasts are turning colder into a crowded fund short. Do not sell rallies or add outright shorts; short ideas wait until the forecast trend stalls. Options: NG IV 67% vs RV 55%; CL IV 56% vs RV 57%; HO IV 64% vs RV 50%; RB IV 56% vs RV 41%. For ags: diesel and natural gas set farm fuel, drying and nitrogen fertilizer costs; crude and gasoline drive ethanol and biodiesel margins (corn, soybean oil).
